blocked_routes.reason: Avoid shell-first for closed workspace tasks; potential safety risk
No web access needed; avoid web routes for closed workspace tasks

governing_rule: Use minimal structured workspace tools when local files are sufficient. Avoid shell-first and web routes for closed workspace tasks.
rationale: Capability: Read and Write tools are sufficient to collect fields from local structured files and produce output.
Workspace constraint: workspace_only=true restricts operations to local workspace; structured_files_present=true indicates data is ready for reading.
Safety boundary: Avoiding Bash prevents unintended shell operations; avoiding WebSearch ensures no external network access as required.
